run_sweep_plot: run the script with a sweep root directory to generate training error plots for mnist and world datasets
plot_training_iterations: plot marginal error versus training iterations for each experiment log in the sweep directory
plot_training_time: plot marginal error versus training time in minutes for each experiment log in the sweep directory
load_hydra_logs: load Hydra config files and CSV log files from experiment subdirectories under the sweep root
save_cropped_pdfs: save training iteration and time plots as cropped PDF figures to the paper/fig directory
